task: Instrumented PreCompact emergency kills and native-resume watch with session-level diagnostics, added ASKR_DEVELOPER environment override for multi-user bot scenarios, and marked superseded decisions in audit trail to prevent stale guidance.
discussion_summary: Two parallel sessions converged on diagnostic instrumentation to enable root-cause analysis of premature session termination and slow recovery without guessing. Session 1 built the five-stage quota-reset automation pipeline and fixed daemon-suspension gaps during macOS sleep/wake. This session completed Stages 1 and 3 of instrumentation (PreCompact kills now log session_id, context_pct, and already_companioned flag; _watch_for_native_resume logs session_id, resolved reset_at, and grace-adjusted deadline). All 702 tests pass. Additionally, added ASKR_DEVELOPER environment variable override to support shared bots running Claude Code on behalf of multiple users without touching machine-level config, and established a convention for marking reversed decisions with '[SUPERSEDED]' prefix to keep audit trail intact while preventing stale guidance from being read as current.

decisions.decision: Separate the account-wide announcement dedup (quota_triggered_windows, keyed by reset_at) from per-session resume verification (quota_resume_verified, keyed by session_id::reset_at)
decisions.reason: Quota is account-wide so the announcement fires once per window by design (correct, stops duplicate voice/Discord spam across concurrent sessions) — but each concurrent session is a separate terminal needing its own resume check. Reusing the same dedup for both silently left every session but the first with nobody watching it after the announcement fired once.

decisions.decision: Maintain 180-second grace buffer after real quota-reset time before checking whether the transcript resumed natively
decisions.reason: Allows time for Claude Code to detect the reset, reconnect, and resume writing; 180s is conservative enough to catch slow reconnects without waiting indefinitely; this is intentional design, not a bug

decisions.decision: Accept stale quota percentage (e.g. '99%') in voice announcements when reset has already passed before the announcement fires
decisions.reason: Cosmetic wording issue only; the mechanism is correct (Phase 4 verification checks whether transcript actually resumed, not the announced percentage); fixing the wording is lower priority than fixing the concurrent-session verification bug

decisions.decision: Resolve the target pid's tty before emergency SIGKILL and write the mouse-tracking disable sequence (\x1b[?1000l) directly to the device afterward
decisions.reason: SIGKILL gives Claude Code's TUI no chance to disable mouse-tracking mode it enables on start, leaving the terminal dumping raw SGR mouse reports as garbage text; direct device write bypasses the killed process entirely

decisions.decision: [SUPERSEDED] Use Escape key (\x1b) for quota-reset menu automation, not arrow-navigation or digit-selection
decisions.reason: This week's work explicitly retired same-session Escape/cont automation because Claude Code now handles quota-resume natively; decision is still in audit trail but no longer active guidance

decisions.decision: Implement quota-reset automation in five stages: (1) instrumentation for detection, (2) PID→terminal bridge, (3) wait for real data, (4) wire automation, (5) safety-net detection
decisions.reason: Stages 1, 2, and 5 are buildable today without live events and carry no automation risk; Stage 3 requires real quota-limit data; Stage 4 (the only risky stage) waits for Stage 3 before proceeding

decisions.decision: PID→vscode.Terminal targeting uses _get_ancestor_pids to walk the process tree and findTerminalByAncestorPids to match Terminal by ancestor PID
decisions.reason: Claude Code may spawn multiple terminal instances; ancestor-PID matching is more reliable than terminal title or index-based targeting and survives terminal renames

decisions.decision: Instrument PreCompact kills with session_id, context_pct, and already_companioned flag logged AFTER the kill to preserve race-winning behavior
decisions.reason: Logging before kill would add latency and risk losing the race; logging after preserves the hook's whole point while enabling diagnosis of which race (Trigger A never ran vs. opened companion but lost) is being lost

decisions.decision: Instrument _watch_for_native_resume and quota-fallback paths with session_id, resolved reset_at, and grace-adjusted deadline up front before waiting
decisions.reason: Next slow cont can be diagnosed from the log directly instead of reconstructing guesses across multiple incidents; shows whether askr was legitimately waiting for a future reset or actually stalled

decisions.decision: Mark reversed/retired decisions with '[SUPERSEDED]' prefix instead of deleting them or presenting them unmarked as current
decisions.reason: Audit trail must stay intact for traceability, but unmarked reversed decisions sitting next to new ones read as stale/naive guidance. Prefix makes the reversal explicit without losing history.

decisions.decision: Support ASKR_DEVELOPER environment variable override in load_developer() for multi-user bot deployments
decisions.reason: Shared bots running Claude Code on behalf of many users need per-run identity without touching machine-level config; environment override is the standard pattern for this use case
